title: D11: validate once, reuse, invalidate, repair, reuse again
prompt: pick up the cube and set it on the platform; keep going until you can verify it is placed

outcome.text: Five panels on one clock: the validation episode that promoted the skill; reuse in the mirrored layout from the persisted store; the retrieval refused after the cube grew, similarity shown and inert; the revalidation under the grown cube that issued version 2; reuse again with version 2.

notes: See docs/results/g11-report.md. One tree run on physics from the skill store: a certificate promoted only after an independent validation set passed, reused only where its six-facet context matches exactly, invalidated when a dimension changes and revalidated by a new outcome; restarts open a fresh session on the checkpoint's physical state and reconstruct their belief from the sensors alone. Rendered from recorded states at real-time playback with the simulation clock and the tree's verdict in the banner; frames.json beside the MP4 maps every frame to its recorded sample.
